title: Dihydroartemisinin Attenuated Intervertebral Disc Degeneration via Inhibiting PI3K/AKT and NF-kappaB Signaling Pathways.
authors: Liao, Zhiheng; Su, Deying; Liu, Hengyu; Xu, Caixia; Wu, Jinna; Chen, Yuyu; Guo, Weimin; Zhang, Shun; Li, Zhuling; Ke, Xiaona; Wang, Tingting; Zhou, Taifeng; Su, Peiqiang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究双氢青蒿素通过抑制PI3K/AKT和NF-kappaB信号通路缓解椎间盘退变，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Intervertebral disc degeneration (IDD) is the leading cause of low back pain (LBP). However, effective therapeutic drugs for IDD remain to be further explored. Inflammatory cytokines play a pivotal role in the onset and progression of IDD. Dihydroartemisinin (DHA) has been well reported to have powerful anti-inflammatory effects, but whether DHA could ameliorate the development of IDD remained unclear. In this study, the effects of DHA on extracellular matrix (ECM) metabolism and cellular senescence were firstly investigated in nucleus pulposus cells (NPCs) under tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNFalpha)-induced inflammation. Meanwhile, AKT agonist sc-79 was used to determine whether DHA exerted its actions through regulating PI3K/AKT and NF-kappaB signaling pathways. Next, the therapeutic effects of DHA were tested in a puncture-induced rat IDD model. Finally, we detected the activation of PI3K/AKT and NF-kappaB signaling pathways in clinical degenerative nucleus pulposus specimens. We demonstrated that DHA ameliorated the imbalance between anabolism and catabolism of extracellular matrix and alleviated NPCs senescence induced by TNFalpha in vitro. Further, we illustrated that DHA mitigated the IDD progression in a puncture-induced rat model. Mechanistically, DHA inhibited the activation of PI3K/AKT and NF-kappaB signaling pathways induced by TNFalpha, which was undermined by AKT agonist sc-79. Molecular docking predicted that DHA bound to the PI3K directly. Intriguingly, we also verified the activation of PI3K/AKT and NF-kappaB signaling pathways in clinical degenerative nucleus pulposus specimens, suggesting that DHA may qualify itself as a promising drug for mitigating IDD.
abstract_zh: 椎间盘退变（IDD）是腰痛（LBP）的主要原因。然而，针对IDD的有效治疗药物仍有待进一步探索。炎症细胞因子在IDD的发生和进展中发挥关键作用。双氢青蒿素（DHA）已被广泛报道具有强大的抗炎作用，但DHA是否能改善IDD的发展尚不清楚。在本研究中，首先在肿瘤坏死因子α（TNFα）诱导的炎症条件下，探讨了DHA对髓核细胞（NPCs）中细胞外基质（ECM）代谢和细胞衰老的影响。同时，使用AKT激动剂sc-79来确定DHA是否通过调节PI3K/AKT和NF-kappaB信号通路发挥作用。接下来，在穿刺诱导的大鼠IDD模型中测试了DHA的治疗效果。最后，我们检测了临床退变髓核标本中PI3K/AKT和NF-kappaB信号通路的激活情况。我们证明，DHA在体外改善了细胞外基质合成代谢与分解代谢之间的失衡，并减轻了TNFα诱导的NPCs衰老。进一步，我们阐明DHA在穿刺诱导的大鼠模型中缓解了IDD的进展。机制上，DHA抑制了TNFα诱导的PI3K/AKT和NF-kappaB信号通路的激活，而这种抑制作用被AKT激动剂sc-79所削弱。分子对接预测DHA直接与PI3K结合。有趣的是，我们还在临床退变髓核标本中验证了PI3K/AKT和NF-kappaB信号通路的激活，这表明DHA可能成为缓解IDD的有前景的药物。
